messages.content: tor kache ekta jinis bolbo, tui ki mone koro manush true self ta sobar samne show kore naki alada version rakhe sobar jonno?
Mone hoy sobai kichuta alada version rakhe context onujayi, eta manipulation na, eta social adaptation. Tui ki mone koro nijer sathe emon koris?
hae, office e ekrokom, bondhu der sathe onno rokom
That's completely normal actually, different contexts pull out different facets of the same person. Kintu ekta jaigay tui most authentic feel koris, kothay?
close friends der sathe, ekdom unfiltered thakte pari
Sei space ta protect kora important, karon shobar samne unfiltered thaka exhausting ar shobar samne masked thaka lonely - balance ta oi close circle e paoa jai.
